capabilities: Sync selected files to a Hugo content directory
Convert Obsidian tags to Hugo tags
Filter out specified headers and their content
Configure the Hugo root and content paths
extras: Installation instructions reference disabling Safe Mode, which suggests an older Obsidian version; troubleshooting relies on checking the console log for errors.
problem: Obsidian's markdown and tag formats differ from what a Hugo static site expects, so publishing notes requires manual conversion and copying.

relations.evidence: sync your Obsidian notes with Hugo, a popular static site generator

summary: Syncs selected Obsidian notes into a Hugo site by converting tags and frontmatter and copying files to the Hugo content directory.
